Experimental portfolio laboratory using self-authored synthetic data and simulated exact-action approvals; no production security claim.
Held-out lineage is author-declared and mechanically checked; no independent semantic split audit. Task-bootstrap intervals do not remove shared-family correlation.
Attack insertion is document-body append; tool-result-field insertion and arbitrary encoded or semantic disclosure detection are not implemented.
A host-wide public-network audit, artifact quota, additional live crash/cancellation/orphan cleanup evidence, independent clean-checkout reproduction, and final recording remain acceptance gaps.
One pinned local model, one sampling seed, and fixed payloads; zero observed wins cannot establish zero risk. Prompt-only release ablation is separate and not yet implemented in the frozen runner.
Raw artifacts remain privileged. Local checksums and the freeze detect inconsistency, not forgery by the machine owner. Container containment is not microVM-grade isolation.

The v1 corpus holds out forty decision-rule templates in eight families, while sharing tool/resource plumbing and attack mechanisms with development. It does not establish independent workflow or unseen-attack generalization; legitimate confidential-input receipt utility is outside this corpus.
